The developers behind the open source [watchfaces](watchfaces.md) and [apps](watchapps.md) in this directory. Pick a developer to see everything they've made, which you can sort by release date, update date or name, and filter to just watchfaces or apps.

The number next to each name is how many open source watchfaces and apps they have. Use the search box to find a developer by name. [How these lists are made](about-app-lists.md)
